post.summary: Makes a key. The response is the only time the key itself is ever shown.
Exchanges an API key for a short-lived access token (a bearer token, no
post.description:
cookies and no refresh token). A key that is unknown, revoked, expired or
whose owner is suspended is refused the same way, without saying which.

delete.summary: Deletes the caller's account (soft delete) and signs them out everywhere.
Signs the account out everywhere, this device included: every refresh
delete.description: session is revoked and the presented access token is denylisted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Made by the client; a retry with the same key applies once

get.summary: Local dev backend only: serves back what `upload_local` wrote. No auth —
get.description:
mirrors the S3 backend, where these objects are publicly readable (see
`public_media.rs`'s module doc).

put.summary: Local dev backend only: `presign_upload` hands the caller this route's
put.description:
own URL as the "presigned" upload target (there's no real presigning
concept without S3), so the caller PUTs the file bytes here directly.
Auth-gated (unlike `serve_local`) since it's a write.

get.summary: A page of a table with secret columns masked. Opening a table is recorded in

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in the subject or body

total.description: How many accounts match the filters, across all pages.

contact.description: The primary contact (email address or phone number).

ApiKeyRes.description: An API key as it is listed. Never the key, never its hash.

prefix.description: The first characters of the key, enough to recognise it.

expires_in_days.description: 1 to 730; omitted means it doesn't expire.

CreatedApiKeyRes.description: A new key. `key` is shown **once**, here, and can't be retrieved again.

ErrorRes.description:
Mirrors the error envelope every non-2xx response actually uses (see
`tagwise_shared::errors::AppError`) — this type exists purely so the
OpenAPI document can describe that shape; nothing constructs it at
runtime.

refresh_token.description: Optional for the same reason as `RefreshReq::refresh_token`.

preferences.description:
Free-form settings (appearance, dashboard choices, notification and
onboarding state). A JSON object.

refresh_token.description:
Optional — the browser client omits this and relies on the
`tw_refresh` HttpOnly cookie instead (WO-05: no tokens in
`localStorage`, including the refresh token). Non-browser clients
(mobile app, `curl`, tests) pass it explicitly here.

dev_code.description:
Present only in development (`OTP_DEV_ECHO_ENABLED=true`), never in
staging/production — config refuses to start with it enabled there.

preferences.description: Merged into the stored preferences: top-level keys replace, others stay.

delta.description: Positive to receive, negative to issue.

tag_prefix.description: Two to five capital letters, used in tags (MCT-00001).

version.description: The version the caller loaded. A stale version gets 409 with the current asset.

result.description: found, wrong_place, unexpected, unknown or repeat.

link.description: Where opening it should go, relative to the site.

grafana_url.description: Where to open Grafana itself, if it is known.

redacted.description: The column holds a secret; its values are masked.

query.description: The first 160 characters of the current or last statement.

limit_bytes.description: Absent when the container has no memory limit.

context.description:
Where the requester was and what they were using (page, browser). An
object, at most 4 KB.

configured.description: `false` when no database has been given to the viewer.

internal.description: Only ever true in the staff view.

counts.description: How many tickets are in each status, across the whole queue.

RegisterStats.description:
The register at a glance, from the register service: workspaces, assets
out or missing, stock below its reorder level, stock-takes running.

up.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape it; absent if Prometheus has no series.

internal.description: A staff-only note the requester never sees, and that notifies nobody.

messages.description: The whole conversation, including internal notes.

events.description: Everything staff did to it, and when.

StaffTicketRes.description: A ticket as staff see it: who raised it, who has it, and the context.

StatusRes.description: Is a source set up, and could it be reached? `message` says why not.

row_estimate.description: Postgres's own estimate; exact counts come with the rows.

reason.description: Why — 3 to 300 characters; kept in the audit log.

TicketRes.description: A ticket as its requester sees it.

assigned.description: Whether a member of staff has taken it.

error_ratio.description:
Failed requests as a share of all requests (0 to 1); absent when there
was no traffic to measure.
